name: secret-patterns-ignore-case
source: real change in the muellim repository: Task 4 review fix to src/diff/filter.ts, secret patterns ignore letter case
diff:
diff --git a/src/diff/filter.ts b/src/diff/filter.ts
--- a/src/diff/filter.ts
+++ b/src/diff/filter.ts
@@ -2,14 +2,17 @@ import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
 import { join } from 'node:path'
 import type { Chunk } from '../types.js'
 
-/** Paths Muellim never sends to the AI, even when they are part of the change. */
+/** Paths Muellim never sends to the AI, even when they are part of the change. Case is ignored. */
 const SECRET_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
-  /(^|\/)\.env(\.[^/]*)?$/,
-  /\.(pem|key|p12|pfx|jks|keystore)$/,

-  /(^|\/)\.npmrc$/,
-  /(^|\/)\.netrc$/,
-  /(^|\/)credentials(\.[a-z]+)?$/,
+  /(^|\/)\.env[^/]*$/i,
+  /\.(pem|key|p12|pfx|jks|keystore|ppk|p8)$/i,
+  /(^|\/)id_[a-z0-9_]+(\.pub)?$/i,
+  /(^|\/)\.npmrc$/i,

 ]

question.topic: secret file names in upper case
question.prompt: After this change, a commit adds a file named certs/Prod.PEM. Does Muellim send it to the AI, and why did the patterns need the i flag?
question.answerKey: No. The i flag makes every secret pattern ignore letter case, so Prod.PEM or .ENV match. Before, only lower-case names matched, so the same secret files spelled with capitals were sent to the AI.
rubric: the file is treated as a secret and not sent, because the patterns now ignore case
without the flag, upper- or mixed-case names of secret files did not match and were sent to the AI

answers.text: It is filtered out. The /i flag makes .ENV or Prod.PEM match the secret patterns; before, only lowercase names were caught, so those files would have been sent.
not sent, case insensitive now. the old regexes were case sensitive so .PEM slipped past the filter and went to the model
It is sent, because the pattern list only covers .pem in lower case.
It is not sent. The i flag was added so the regular expressions run faster on long paths.
